page_title: SHU 0-6 ARS | Sheffield Utd v Arsenal 04/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sends a chip pass into the box, but Ivo Grbic is quickest to intercept the ball.
90+3' Gabriel Jesus receives a sweet cross inside the box from William Saliba (Arsenal), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
90+1' Samuel Barrott interrupts the game for a tactical foul by George Baldock (Sheffield Utd).
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) heads on.
88' Flag goes up against Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
88' A cross into the box from Cedric (Arsenal) is cleared.
87' Cedric (Arsenal) swings it in and Gabriel Jesus gets on the end of it, but Ivo Grbic shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
86' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Arsenal.

84' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.
84' The resulting corner from Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) comes to nothing.

82' A sweet pass finds Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the right side of the goal. Ivo Grbic is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
82' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

81' William Osula (Sheffield Utd) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Arsenal.

78' Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
78' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Arsenal.
77' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Arsenal have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) will replace Declan Rice.
73' Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
70' Fabio Vieira (Arsenal) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
68' Flag up against Fabio Vieira (Arsenal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
65' Substitution. Ben White walks off the pitch and Cedric (Arsenal) comes on as a substitute.
65' Mikel Arteta prepares a substitution. Jorginho is replaced by Thomas Partey (Arsenal).
64' Gabriel Martinelli doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
64' Substitution. Anel Ahmedhodzic makes way for Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd).
63' The game is interrupted now, Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
62' A pass from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is intercepted by David Raya and the move breaks down.
61' Declan Rice (Arsenal) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
60' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Good work from Arsenal as they win a corner.
58' 0 - 6 Goal! Kai Havertz slips it to Ben White (Arsenal) on the edge of the box and he finds the bottom left corner with a great effort. The score is 0:6.
55' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
53' A lofted pass picks out Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
52' Declan Rice (Arsenal) hits a dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal from the promising free kick. His low shot is stopped by a well prepared Ivo Grbic.
51' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd). Samuel Barrott saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Arsenal have a free kick.
50' The resulting corner from Declan Rice (Arsenal) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
49' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Arsenal.
46' Mikel Arteta makes a half-time substitution. Fabio Vieira comes on in place of Bukayo Saka (Arsenal).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) is replaced by Andre Brooks.
46' Chris Wilder makes a switch. George Baldock is coming on in place of James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) at the start of the second period.
46' Half-time substitution. Chris Wilder decided to make a change. Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) is replaced by William Osula.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45+3' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) sprays a pass out to Gabriel Martinelli, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
43' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
42' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) works the corner short.
39' 0 - 5 It's 0:5! Bukayo Saka feeds Declan Rice (Arsenal) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
39' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
37' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) wins the ball after the corner kick and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
36' Arsenal force a corner. They send men into the box.
34' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
31' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
29' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Samuel Barrott ignores the protests.

25' 0 - 4 Goal! Great play by Gabriel Martinelli releases Kai Havertz (Arsenal) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 0:4.
24' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
22' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Ivo Grbic.
18' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
17' Oliver Norwood goes off the pitch and Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
15' 0 - 3 Goal! Jakub Kiwior plays it to Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Ivo Grbic. 0:3.
13' 0 - 2 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 0:2.
11' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.

9' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and immediately unleashes a shot which is wide of the mark. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
9' There's an opportunity for Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
8' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Arsenal.
7' Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) makes a strong challenge and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
5' 0 - 1 Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) was like a fox in the box, burying the ball into the bottom right corner of the goal. Excellent finish!
5' Ben White (Arsenal) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Kai Havertz.

3' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. Ivo Grbic shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
2' OFF THE WOODWORK! Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Samuel Barrott was nominated as the referee for this game.
